title: Open WebUI Mermaid preview -- T1059.007 securityLevel:'loose' + innerHTML renders attacker SVG/JS
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-54011 (GHSA-v8qj-hxv7-mgvv,
CVSS 8.7 HIGH), affecting Open WebUI prior to 0.9.6.

Open WebUI renders Mermaid diagram blocks from Markdown files in the
file-preview panel and inserts the generated SVG into the DOM via
`innerHTML`. Because Mermaid is configured with `securityLevel: 'loose'`
-- the setting that permits Mermaid diagram syntax to include raw
clickable links and script-capable constructs -- attacker-controlled
Mermaid content reaching this render path executes as JavaScript in the
application's own origin. The advisory notes a working payload was
validated specifically through the Markdown FILE PREVIEW path (not
chat rendering), giving an attacker who can get a victim to preview a
malicious Markdown file full script execution under the victim's
authenticated session.

Detection logic flags a Markdown file preview request whose content
contains a Mermaid fenced code block with embedded HTML/script markup
-- ordinary Mermaid diagram syntax (nodes, edges, flowchart directives)
has no legitimate reason to contain `<script>` tags or event-handler
attributes.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD), fixed in 0.9.6.
